issues.issue: Did the IAD reasonably apply the Ribic factors, including the schizophrenia diagnosis?
issues.applicant_position: The IAD failed to properly consider his schizophrenia diagnosis when applying the Ribic factors.
issues.result_quote: This is all that is required to establish that the IAD made a reasonable decision on this issue.

issues.issue: Did the IAD reasonably consider humanitarian and compassionate factors, including his mental health?
issues.applicant_position: The IAD failed to reasonably consider his mental health when assessing the H&C factors.
issues.result_quote: I conclude that the IAD’s assessment of the H&C factors was balanced and therefore reasonable.
